_how: To file a week, add archive/YYYY-MM-DD/ named with that week's Monday. Put grant.html, paper.html, and idea.html in it, and leave out a file when that path did not run. Append one object to weeks. monday is YYYY-MM-DD. label is Week of <Monday's date in the form 28 September 2026>. The page sorts by monday, newest first.
